archive_policy: Verify whole archive SHA256 before reading any member. Select only the specified regular file; reject links and duplicate members. Keep upstream notices. Downloads occur only during explicit kit preparation.
provenance_limits: EVMole uses the official binary wheel, not a local reproducible build of the catalog revision.
WhatsABI npm src files were compared with all 34 matching catalog TypeScript files.
Published artifact digest verification does not verify Sigstore signatures or authenticate the entire host.

reproduction.npm_reconstruction: Runner extracts each verified tgz package/ member tree into its path from evm-native-npm-pins.json, including nested dependencies. Exactly 16 package archives are required.

steps: Create an empty private kit directory at a caller-chosen path.
Download direct_downloads to their kit_file names and verify SHA256.
Download the Node archive, verify its archive hash, extract only the named node member, verify its member hash, and copy to kit/node. Preserve its LICENSE.
For every package in the pinned npm manifest, download url into kit/filename and verify sha256. Do not run npm install or lifecycle scripts.
Mark only solc and node executable. Keep wheels and npm archives intact; they are extracted into fresh private directories by the native runner.
